Commentary.Commentary: Meg Lanning drops the mic and hurries to the podium as she lifts the World Cup trophy along with her teammates. Australia Women are the champions for the SEVENTH-TIME. One month of wonderful cricket in New Zealand comes to an end. Hands down, this World Cup had thrillers, climaxes, and nail-biters. Hope you enjoyed the coverage just as much as we did. We conclude this tournament here but there is a lot of cricket happening across the globe. But from here, it is goodbye!

Meg Lanning, the victorious skipper says that they have been very consistent throughout the tournament, and to perform the whole tournament the same way is remarkable and adds that they deserved to win today. Mentions that they knew they needed a number of players to contribute throughout the tournament, and even off the field, they have had great support from the staff and coaches. Informs that she was nervous all the way through the second innings, and they knew England would come hard at them. States that it is important to have some depth and they can't rely on one or two players. Concludes by thanking the England team for such a competitive game, and says that they will enjoy this victory!
The newly made champions, Australia Women will collect their medals now.

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women. She says it was a 50-50 decision at the toss but credit to Australia Women for putting up a show. Admits it was one of the best innings (Alyssa Healy's inning) she has seen in the World Cup. Adds that even Natalie Sciver's inning was remarkable and they missed out on a big partnership. Tells that she is proud of the group, and staff and they showed character to turn things around but unfortunately it didn't work out. Informs there is Commonwealth games at home, World Cup coming up so they are busy but proud of themselves. Credits the staff to keep them on the road and the crowd as well for turning up.
Now, England Women team come up to the podium as they collect the runners-up medal.

ALYSSA HEALY is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH AND THE PLAYER OF THE TOURNAMENT! She says she is 32 and she has seen it all, her team just sets out for big events and everyone sets their minds to win it and she adds that she is grateful for the opportunity. Mentions that she could not ask her anything more today, they put a huge total on the board, they have done it in the entire tournament, but it feels good to do it again on this best stage. Adds that the most challenging part was the first 10 overs since two world-class players were swinging the ball. Informs that Rachael Haynes did the bulk of the work at the top throughout the tournament, and she really enjoyed being there!
The match officials will receive their medals first for the wonderful work throughout the tournament.
Stay tuned for the presentation

Ellyse Perry says that today was just wonderful, and they had a wonderful crowd in. Mentions that it was pretty close for her playing this game but a huge amount of gratitude for their medical team for helping her recover. On being asked if she wanted to bowl today, she says she did mark her run-up when they got to the ground but it was a long shot. Adds that it was just a shift of attitude and mindset from the World Cup in 2017. Alana King is also up for a chat. She says to go invincible shows the character of the game. Adds that the batters will come for her and she likes that challenge. Mentions, from the moment she walked in she, was welcomed with open arms. On Healy's inning, she says she was eating a bit of popcorn on the side and enjoying the show she was putting out.

Rachael Haynes says that it was nice to contribute some runs, and most importantly feels nice to win now. Mentions that Alyssa Healy was phenomenal, one of the best knocks she has ever seen. Informs that the World Cup in 2017 did not go as per their plans, but they executed their plans here, and they were consistent in this tournament, and it was very special.

Alyssa Healy, the star of the World Cup final is up for a quick chat. She says that it was a special game of cricket, a high-scoring one. The victory still has not sunk in, but it is pretty cool to win! Mentions that their job was half done, they had a very good total on the board, they had to just bowl well, but it was a good game of cricket. States that they wanted to get out there and put a big total on the board, and she is proud of the entire batting unit. Informs that everyone has worked very hard for this, and credits the full team.

Earlier in the day, we witnessed the greatest knock ever seen in the World Cup. Alyssa Healy made her name all over the world with a phenomenal innings of 170. She was well supported by Rachael Haynes and Beth Mooney. England Women were brave in their chase but not good enough to defend the title.

Australia Women stuck to their plans. They kept picking up wickets at regular intervals and kept the pressure intact. It was just the innings from Natalie Sciver that gave them a few hiccups but they made sure to keep the other side of the wickets tumbling. Even the fielding was much better from Australia as compared to England, which does make a huge difference in the mega-events. If England would have taken those drop catches, things could have been different.

Natalie Sciver fought hard and was stuck till the end but she was left alone in the middle to chase a humongous total. There were small partnerships from Amy Jones, Sophia Dunkley, and Charlotte Dean but no one just stayed there with her. In these mammoth chases, the openers play a crucial role but England lost both inside the powerplay and they were under pressure right from the start.

AUSTRALIA ARE WORLD CHAMPIONS! They have won their seventh World Cup and they truly deserve to be crowned the champions! They have done nothing wrong in the entire tournament. They are 'The Invincibles' and indeed the No.1 ranked team in the World. Mighty Aussies for a reason! Take a bow, Australia! Here come the other teammates and there is a huge group of Yellow in the middle, celebrating the success. Nothing to take away from England and especially Natalie Sciver who played one of the best knocks you will ever see in the chase. She gave a glimpse of hope to England Women, but unfortunately could not get her team over the line.

OUT! CAUGHT! AUSTRALIA ARE WORLD CHAMPIONS! Jess Jonassen finishes things off! She grabs her third wicket! A fuller ball, flatter delivery, around off. Anya Shrubsole dances down the wicket, and looks to clear the fielder at mid off. But the ball goes off the bottom of the bat and flies just over mid off. Ashleigh Gardner backtracks, and pouches it safely! Natalie Sciver remains unbeaten, she fought well! Australia Women win by 71 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Ashleigh Gardner b Jess Jonassen

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, outside off. Anya Shrubsole chops it towards point.
Fuller delivery, around middle. Natalie Sciver tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Anya Shrubsole will be on strike!

FOUR! CLOSE! A flatter ball, comes in with the angle. Natalie Sciver hangs back and tries to pull this but the ball goes off the inside edge, and just over the leg pole towards fine leg for a boundary!
Loopy delivery, full, around middle. Anya Shrubsole blocks it out. 77 runs needed off 42 balls with one wicket in hand!
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Natalie Sciver tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Anya Shrubsole knocks to long on for a single.
Anya Shrubsole is the last batter for England Women!

OUT! TAKEN! Australia Women are inches away now. Tossed up, full, and on middle. Dean tries to reverse hit it over backward point but fails to get any elevation. Jess Jonassen there takes an easy catch and England Women have only one wicket to work with.
Commentary.Howout: c Jess Jonassen b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on middle. Dean scoops it to long leg and takes a couple of runs.
A low full toss, angling on middle, Sciver reverse sweeps it to point for a single.
A single as this is drilled to long on.
Length ball, on middle. Sciver heaves it to deep mid-wicket. The long on fielder runs across and does well to keep it away from the ropes. Two runs.
Fuller and outside off. Dean drives it to the left of mid off. Good stop there. A single.
A flighted ball, full and on middle. Sciver tucks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a quick single.
Too full and on off, drilled to mid-wicket.
Shorter and slower around off. Dean pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, dragged to deep mid-wicket for a single. 88 runs needed in 54 balls.
Tossed up, full and on off. Now Dean reverse sweeps it fine past short fine leg for two runs.
Tad short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and outside off. Sciver shuffles and looks to squeeze it out but inside edges it onto the pads.
Shorter and on off, pulled away wide of long on and the fielder dives to her right to save a couple of runs.
FOUR! Good shot! A flatter ball, on middle. Sciver reverse hits it, flat and past point for a boundary. 50-run stand is up.
Ashleigh Gardner is into the attack.
Full  and outside off, pushed to long off  for a single.
Fuller now, around middle and off. Charlotte Dean drives it to long off for a single.

Charlotte Dean tries to be innovative here! A fuller ball, outside off. Charlotte Dean looks to scoop this, but the ball goes off the toe end and lobs up and lands on the off side. Charlotte Dean wanted a single there thinking she the ball has gone over the keeper. But she is sent back by Natalie Sciver!
Fuller, slower through the air, around middle. Charlotte Dean pushes it back to the bowler.
Spinning away, outside off, shorter ball. Charlotte Dean taps it towards point.
Flatter ball, shorter in length, around middle. Natalie Sciver punches it towards long on for a single.
Jess Jonassen is back on.
Fuller delivery, around middle. Natalie Sciver pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Charlotte Dean guides it towards third man for a single.
Full, outside off, Natalie Sciver drives it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Edgy! On a length, around middle and off. Natalie Sciver shuffles across and looks to scoop this over fine leg, but the ball goes off the edge towards third man for a boundary!
Fraction shorter now, around middle. Charlotte Dean pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Low full toss, slower ball, around middle. Natalie Sciver flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Turning away, outside off, shorter ball. Charlotte Dean pushes it towards the fielder at point.

SO CLOSE! Almost dragged on! Fuller ball, loopy delivery, around middle. Natalie Sciver get down to sweep but the ball goes off the inside edge and misses the leg pole by a whisker! It goes towards fine leg and three runs are taken!
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Charlotte Dean taps it towards point for a quick single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Charlotte Dean hangs back and blocks it out.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Natalie Sciver sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Quicker, flatter, around middle. Natalie Sciver defends it out.
On a length again, outside off. Natalie Sciver punches it towards sweeper cover for single. She retains the strike!
Length delivery, outside off. Charlotte Dean steers it towards third man for a single.
Very full this time, on middle. Natalie Sciver knocks it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Cheeky! On a length, around middle and leg. Natalie Sciver walks across and scoops it past the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, around middle. Natalie Sciver pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length, around middle and leg. Natalie Sciver heaves it towards deep square leg. Ellyse Perry runs to her left, dives and stops the ball with her left hand. Excellent fielding! Two taken!
Shorter ball, on middle. Charlotte Dean defends it out.
FOUR! Another boundary of the over! This is shorter, outside off. Charlotte Dean hangs back and punches it past cover for a boundary.
Loopy delivery, full, around middle. Charlotte Dean looks to flick this, but the ball goes off the leading edge towards point, on a bounce.
Very full, around middle. Natalie Sciver knocks it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Natalie Sciver is still fighting hard! Top shot! A loopy ball, full, around off. Natalie Sciver steps down and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary!
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Charlotte Dean tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Very full and on middle. Dean turns it to mid-wicket for a single. 134 needed in 90 balls.
Full and on off. Sciver works it to 45 for a single.
Fuller and on middle, Sciver flicks with soft hands to square leg and comes back for the second run.
Length ball, outside off, Dean cuts it uppishly and past point for a single.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.

Century for Natalie Sciver! What a fighting knock this is from Natalie Sciver! She deserves all the applause from the crowd. She is playing her knock despite wickets falling on the other end. Length ball, on the pads. Sciver sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
On middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Charlotte Dean walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Sciver watches from the other end, she is running out of partners! Tossed up, full and on middle. Cross pushes it uppishly and to the right of Jess Jonassen who dives superbly to that side and holds onto it.
Slower and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Sciver moves to 97 but she needs support from the other end! Floated, full on leg. Sciver reverse hits it very hard and through cover-point for a boundary.
Angles a length ball, on leg, hit to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on off. Sciver punches it to mid on.
Very full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Kate Cross comes to the crease.

OUT! LBW! Sophie Ecclestone goes now and Australia Women are 3 wickets away! Touch fuller and around middle, cross-seamed delivery. Ecclestone looks to work it on the leg side but misses and gets rapped plumb on the front pad. A huge appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger.
Fuller ball, angling on middle, flicked in front of square leg for a run.
Length ball, outside off, slower delivery. Ecclestone pulls it late to long leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Much needed! Shorter and around middle. Sciver gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary. She moves into the 90s.
Leg bye! A shorter ball, angling on leg and spinning away from the batter. Ecclestone looks to pull but misses. The ball lobs over the keeper for a leg bye. 200 up for England Women!
A slower ball, leg breaker, outside off. Ecclestone hits it to covers.
Fuller and outside the leg stump. Sciver makes room and bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, around leg. Sciver looks to reverse sweep it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, full from around the wicket. Sciver sweeps it hard and through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length and outside off. Sciver pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball, outside off. Ecclestone guides it to point for a single.
A slower length ball, on off. Tucked to mid-wicket.
Very full and on off.  Ecclestone digs it back to the bowler.
A length ball, outside off. Ecclestone chips it towards cover.
A length ball, outside off. Sciver shuffles and scoops it over the keeper for a single.
Quicker this time, flatter ball, around middle. Natalie Sciver stays in her crease and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single. End of a successful over by Alana King!
Slower through the air, full, around the middle and leg. Sophie Ecclestone sweeps it towards square leg for a single.

Drinks! Australia Women are 4 wickets away from the victory but Natalie Sciver is standing in front of them. The hopes of England lie in her hands and she needs someone to hang on the other side. Sophie Ecclestone comes in now.

OUT! STUMPED! Alana King with yet another wicket! She grabs her third and England Women lose their sixth. They are in a spot of bother now! A lovely delivery by Alana King! A loopy delivery, outside off, spinning away. Katherine Brunt steps down the pitch and looks to push this away, but she misses, as the ball turns away and beats her on the outside edge. Alyssa Healy grabs the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. The replay shows that Katherine Brunt has failed to get her back leg back in time and Katherine Brunt departs!
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Alana King

Commentary.Commentary: Stumping appeal! Katherine Brunt has started walking back. Superb work from Alyssa Healy behind the stumps as she clips the bails off in a flash and the replay shows Brunt had her back foot in the air.
Fuller ball, around middle. Natalie Sciver advances down the ground and knocks it towards long on for a single.
Fuller, down the leg side. Natalie Sciver sweeps it with the toe end of the bat towards square leg for a brace. Natalie Sciver just makes her ground!
FOUR! Perfect execution! Slower through the air, full, around middle. Natalie Sciver gets down on her knee and reverse-sweeps it over point for a boundary.
Shorter ball, outside off. Katherine Brunt taps it towards point.
On a length, around off. Katherine Brunt defends it out.
Full again, around middle. Natalie Sciver paddle scoops this towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Katherine Brunt drives it through cover for a single.
Fuller ball, much straighter now, around middle. Natalie Sciver knocks it to long on for a single.
Angling in, fuller ball, around middle. Natalie Sciver sweeps it towards square leg for a brace.
Katherine Brunt walks out. 178 needed in 132 balls.

OUT! TIMBER! Alana King strikes once again! Just when England Women are trying to build a partnership Australia Women strike back with a wicket! A loopy ball, full in length. This one pitches outside leg, and turns back in. Sophia Dunkley gets low and tries to sweep this but she misses and the ball goes on to hit the leg pole. England Women lose half their side now!
Loopy ball, full, around the leg pole. Sophia Dunkley misses her sweep and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Sophia Dunkley looks to drive this on the leg side. But the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a brace.
Shorter ball, outside off. Sophia Dunkley dabs it towards point.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Natalie Sciver steps down and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery, around middle. Natalie Sciver reverse-sweeps this towards point.
FOUR! Much needed boundary for England Women! On a length, outside off. Sophia Dunkley hangs back and slaps this past cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, down the leg side. Sophia Dunkley looks to sweep this but she misses and gets hit on the pads.
Width on offer this time, on a length. Natalie Sciver pushes it towards cover for a single.
Nipping back in around middle, around middle and leg. Sophia Dunkley nudges it towards square leg.
Another fuller delivery, around off. Natalie Sciver shuffles across and tries to scoop this, but the ball goes her gloves, onto her pads, and towards fine leg for a single.
Full in length, angling in, around middle. Natalie Sciver pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Megan Schutt is back on.
Alana King comes 'round the wicket now, serves a fuller ball, down the leg side. Sophia Dunkley sweeps, but the ball goes off the top edge towards fine leg. Two taken!
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Natalie Sciver flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery, full, around off. Sophia Dunkley advances down the pitch and drills it down to long on for a single.
Pitches it up again, around off. Natalie Sciver steps down the pitch and lifts it towards long off. The fielder there collects the ball on the bounce. Single!
Fuller delivery, on middle. Sophia Dunkley gets down on her knee and scoops it towards fine leg for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Natalie Sciver pushes it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Sciver drags it in front of square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Sciver skips down and turns it to mid on and looks for a quick single. The bails are clipped off at the bowler's end but Sciver made her ground quite comfortably.
Floated and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and on middle, this is pulled hard to square leg for a boundary.

DROPPED! Meg Lanning almost took a blinder! This is full and on off. Dunkley tries to go over extra cover but fails to elevate it. Hits it to the right of Lanning who dives and almost takes it with one hand but fails to stick it. A single.
FOUR! She is in great touch! Tossed up, on middle. Sciver makes room and hammers it over mid off for a boundary.
Slower in the air, short and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single. 150 up for England.

Almost dragged on! A flatter ball, down the leg side, it spins back into the batter. Dunkley looks to sweep it but the ball goes off her gloves and then off the back of her bat and goes just over the stumps. Two runs taken.
Darted on the pads. Sciver paddles it to deep square leg for a single.
Very full and down the leg side. Dunkley sweeps it to 45 for a single.
A full toss angling on leg, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Alana King (4-0-23-1) comes back on!
Tossed up, on middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a run. 213 runs needed in 162 balls.
Very full and on off. Dunkley jams it out on the leg side for one.
An arm ball angling on middle. Sciver looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge and drops safely to covers. A single.
A floated ball on middle. Sciver hops and pushes it back to the bowler.
Touch fuller and around off, drilled to long on for a single.
Shorter and outside off, dragged to long on for a single.
A slower full ball, on off. Dunkley lofts it over covers and takes a couple of runs.
Wide! A bouncer, on middle. Dunkley ducks under it. A wide given for height.
Fifty for Natalie Sciver! A fighting knock from her and it is a long way from here! Game on if she continues to bat like this! On middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for one.
Short of a length and outside off. Sciver pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket. Mooney there, runs to her left, dives and makes a good stop. She hurts herself in the process but gets up quickly.
Length and around off. Dunkley strokes it to covers for a single.
Short one now, on middle. Dunkley sits under it.
Wide! Full ball, down the leg side. Dunkley misses her sweep.
Length and on off. Blocked  out.

LEG BYE! Dunkley pre-meditates the sweep shot and Jess Jonassen serves it too slow and short. Dunkley goes for the sweep but she misses, the ball brushes off her pads and goes towards fine leg. Leg bye taken!
Shorter and on off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, cut to point.
Sophia Dunkley walks in to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Wonderful catch by Alana King! Tossed up, full and around off. Jones comes down the track and tries to go over mid off but cue ends it, in the air and towards mid off. Alana King there, backtracks, does ever so well to keep her eyes on the ball and take it over her heads. Was a very difficult catch and Ausralia are doing really well to take wickets at regular intervals.
Commentary.Howout: c Alana King b Jess Jonassen

Commentary.Commentary: An arm ball, fuller and on off. Sciver drops it in front of point and takes a quick single. A good pick up and throw would have been interesting on the either side.
Full and sliding on the pads, swept to deep backward square leg for a single.
Outside off this time, on a length. Amy Jones cuts it past point for a single. Good over for England Women, 13 runs off it!
Short in length, around middle. Natalie Sciver pulls and finds the fielder at deep square leg. Single taken!
Wide! Too short on this occasion, around off. Natalie Sciver leaves it alone. Wide called for height!

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This time the ball goes off the sweet spot of the bat! Back of a length, around middle. Natalie Sciver swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Darcie Brown drops it short now, around middle. Natalie Sciver pulls this, but the ball goes off the top edge over the keeper's head for a boundary.
On a length now, darting it on the pads. Amy Jones flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Fraction shorter now, around middle. Natalie Sciver pulls it gently towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Fuller, loopy delivery, outside off. Amy Jones lifts it over the fielder at mid off. Two taken!
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Short again, around middle. Amy Jones swivels and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter delivery, around middle. Amy Jones pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Tahlia McGrath runs to her left, slides, and makes a good stop. Two taken!
Flatter delivery, angling in, around middle. Amy Jones nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, full, outside off. Amy Jones defends it out.
Tad shorter, this one comes in with the angle. Natalie Sciver flicks it past square leg off the back foot for a single.
Good-length delivery, around the fifth stump line. Amy Jones dabs it to point.
Another pitched up delivery, around middle and off. Natalie Sciver knocks it to long on and rotates the strike.
Full in length around middle. Amy Jones strokes it down to long on and takes a single.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Amy Jones stays back and looks to cut this but she misses.
Angling in on the pads, on a length. Natalie Sciver flicks it past square leg for a single.
FOUR! Lobely shot! A fuller ball, outside off. Natalie Sciver shuffles across and paddle scoops this towards fine leg for a boundary. 100 up for England Women!
Another full delivery, on middle. Natalie Sciver eases it to long on and takes a single. She retains the strike!
Slower through the air, full, on middle. Amy Jones knocks it towards long on. Single taken!
Back of a length, outside off. Natalie Sciver hangs back and cuts it towards point for a single.
Tad shorter, turning away, around off. Amy Jones pulls it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Fuller again, much straighter now, around middle. Amy Jones pushes it towards mid on.
FOUR! Top shot! Very full, on middle. Amy Jones uses her wrist and flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
fuller ball, width on offer. Amy Jones drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Fuller now, around middle. Natalie Sciver drives it towards long on and takes a single.
Shorter ball, around off. Natalie Sciver pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Fuller now, outside off. Amy Jones pushes it towards cover for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Natalie Sciver pulls it towards square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Natalie Sciver looks to push this away, but the ball goes off the bottom edge back to the bowler.

DRINKS! Australia Women have broken the partnership at the right time! They are on top now. They have grabbed three wickets and put England Women under pressure now. England Women need another partnership here and they need wickets in hand. Amy Jones walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Now, this is plumb and Knight does not think of reviewing it. King does end with a wicket in this over. Slightly short and around off, was the quicker one. Heather Knight went on the back foot to flick it away but gets it on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. The 48-run partnership is broken by Alana King.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.

Sciver and Knight have a chat and Sciver decides to take it upstairs. She takes the review. UltraEdge shows no bat there. Ball Tracking shows wickets missing and Sciver has a sigh of relief. Coming to the ball - A floated, full ball, angling around leg and spinning back in. Sciver tries to paddle it but misses and gets rapped on the pads. An appeal and up goes the ginger. First it looked like might be pitching outside leg but it was the wickets that was missing.
This one comes with the angle, on a length and on off. Sciver chops it to covers.
A leg breaker, outside off. Knight paddles it away to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, quicker and on off. Knight blocks it out.
Length and outside off, cut away to point.
FOUR! England are just hanging there! Short again, on off. Sciver pulls it hard and to deep square leg for a boundary.
Slightly short and outside off, pulled but straight to mid-wicket.
On a length, on middle. Sciver tucks it to mid-wicket. No run there.
FOUR! This stand moves to 42 now! A length ball, on off. Sciver wrists it past mid-wicket for a boundary. Placement.
Outside off, pushed to mid off.
Length and around off. Sciver taps it to covers and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Tossed up, on middle. Sciver sweeps it to deep backward square leg. Ellyse Perry runs to her right, dives and saves a couple of runs.
A single as this full ball is eased down to long on.
A loopy ball, on middle. Sciver chips it to long on for a single.
On middle, flicked straight to mid-wicket.

Was that a chance?  A leg breaker, quicker through the air and on middle. Sciver comes down the track and looks to heave it but inside edges it onto the pads. The ball rolls around and Sciver gets time to get back in her crease.
Length ball, outside off. Sciver guides it to third man for a single.
Length ball, around off. Knight works it off the inner half of the bat to square leg for a single.
A single as this is hit past point.
Length ball, outside off. Sciver cuts it but Haynes at backward point does well to dive to her right and stop it.
Too full and on off. Knight clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, angling on middle, pushed to mid on.
Tahlia McGrath comes into the attack.
Short again but King gets away with it. Sciver cuts it but finds point.
SIX! Walloped! Too short and outside off. Sciver pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie. First six of the finals.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Knight looks to paddle it but gets a top edge and to fine leg for a single.
Short and outside off, slower in the air. Sciver cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A flighted ball,  on middle. Blocked out on the surface.
A length ball, around off. Sciver punches it to covers.
Powerplay 2 time! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over!
On a length, around middle. Heather Knight blocks it out. 13 runs off the over.
FOUR! Classy shot! Third boundary of the innings! Full once again, outside off. Heather Knight leans and creams her drives past cover for a boundary.
Wide! Too short this time, around middle. Heather Knight leaves it alone. Wide called height! Better from Darcie Brown though!
FOUR! And again! A replica of the previous delivery! Full, on the pads. Heather Knight once again flicks it past mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! This is easy for Heather Knight! Straighter now, full and on the pads. Heather Knight flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Shaping away, outside off, fuller ball. Heather Knight drives it towards cover.
Good-length delivery, around middle and off. Heather Knight defends it out solidly.
Pitched up again, around middle. Natalie Sciver drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Full, tailing back in, around middle. Natalie Sciver clips it towards the fielder at square leg.
Shorter ball, nipping back in, outside off. Natalie Sciver hangs back and taps it towards point.
On a length, outside off. Natalie Sciver dabs it towards backward point.
Shorter ball, angling in, around middle. Natalie Sciver pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Swinging in, very full, around middle and leg. Natalie Sciver looks to flic this but she misses and gets hit on her front pad.
Leg bye! Good-length delivery, angling it in on the pads. Natalie Sciver looks to tuck this, but she misses. The ball deflects off the pads and goes towards square leg. The batters steal a leg bye!
Fuller in length now, outside off. Natalie Sciver drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Outside off shaping away, on a length. Natalie Sciver leaves it alone.
Back of a length now, around middle. Heather Knight pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Beaten! On a length, outside off. Heather Knight looks to have a poke at it but she misses.
FOUR! Top shot! Pitches it up, outside off. Heather Knight drives it past the fielder at mid off for a glorious boundary.

NOT OUT! A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no and Australia Women opts for the review! A length ball, tailing back in sharply, around middle and leg. Natalie Sciver looks to flick but she misses and gets rapped on the pad. The replay rolls in. No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge! Ball Tracker shows it was sliding down leg. Australia Women lose a review!
Review! Australia Women take a review for LBW. No bat there. Ball Tracking shows wickets missing and Australia lose their review.
Fuller, around middle. Natalie Sciver pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length, tailing back in, around middle. Natalie Sciver pushes it back to the bowler.
Natalie Sciver walks out in the middle.

OUT! LBW! Megan Schutt strikes once again! She gets rid of Tammy Beaumont who was looking quite good at the crease. It's the inswinger that has done the trick once again! On a length, nipping back in, around middle. Tammy Beaumont looks to flick this but she misses and gets hit on the front pad. A huge appeal for LBW, the umpire raise agrees immediately. Tammy Beaumont consults her skipper at the other end but does not go for the review. She walks back. England Women are 2 down!
On a length, angling in, around off. Tammy Beaumont stays in her crease and taps it towards point.
FOUR! Glorious! Pitches it up, around middle. Tammy Beaumont leans and drives it past mid on for a boundary.
Fuller now, around middle. Heather Knight pushes it towards mid on.

Leg bye! An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! That was probably sliding down leg. A length ball, angling in on the pads. Tammy Beaumont looks to flick but she misses and gets hit on her pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batters steal a leg bye!
On a length, outside off. Tammy Beaumont leans and blocks it out.
Fraction shorter now, around middle. Heather Knight pulls it past mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, darting it on the pads once again. Tammy Beaumont flicks it aerially towards fine leg. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce. Single taken!
FOUR! Easy pickings! This was too full, straight, and on the pads. Tammy Beaumont flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Around off, Knight nudges it to mid-wicket.
Schutt makes it to swing back in, around middle. Beaumont looks to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. A single taken.
Full ball from wide of the crease and angling around off. Kept out.
Fuller and outside off. Beaumont gets low to drive but mistimes it back to Schutt.
A length ball, on off. Beaumont gets inside the line to block it.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
An appeal for LBW but might be angling down! Height might be the issue as well! A length ball, slanting around middle. Beaumont looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Length ball, slower and outside off. Beaumont reaches to the pitch of the ball as she pushes it to covers.
Fuller and on middle, pushed back to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Knight plays it to backward point for a single.
Fullish and outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick single. There is a shy but Beaumont would have made it with a dive.
FOUR! Good shot! Short of a length and on middle. Beaumont pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and on middle, driven straight back and Schutt gets a big hand on it to stop.
Wide! Schutt tries to curl it in but does not get much swing there, straight down the leg side for a wide.
Length and on middle. Defended out.
On the pads, this is hit to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Full and on middle, swing again. Beaumont hits with the swing through mid-wicket for a boundary.
An inswinger, fuller and on the pads. Knight tucks it to square leg for a single.
Heather Knight the skipper of England Women comes to bat at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! The leg pole is uprooted! Fabulous from Megan Schutt! A length ball, just outside off, it nips back in sharply. Wyatt leans into her drive but gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball rattles onto the stumps. Left a big gap and allowed the ball to travel in. Australia with a good start.
A length ball, around off. Beaumont looks to push but gets an inside edge, past the leg pole and to fine leg. Megan Schutt runs to her right and covers a lot of ground to save a couple of runs.
Length and on off. Beaumont defends with a straight bat.
Outside off, cut away straight to point.
Length and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.

Just short! A length ball, outside off, it lands and nips away. Beaumont looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge to the right of the keeper and in front of first slip who dives but the ball falls just short.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Short of a length, on middle. Beaumont looks to pull but gets a top edge and the ball races behind the keeper for a boundary.
Darcie Brown will bowl from the other end. Two slips in place!
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
On a length and just outside off. Wyatt opens her bat face and tries to guide it but misses.
FOUR! First boundary of the chase! A length ball, outside off. Wyatt cuts it aerially and over point for a boundary.
Wide! Full ball, down the leg side from around the wicket. Wyatt misses her flick.
On a length and outside off. Wyatt plays with soft hands to point.
This is full and on middle. Beaumont flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. England and Beaumont are underway.
Starts with a length ball, outside off. Beaumont steps across and blocks it.
